meta.title: OneRome — one person at a time, in Rome
meta.description: OneRome is the dating app for singles in Rome who want something real: one exclusive connection at a time.

landing.title:
One person.
One story.
One Rome.
landing.subtitle: OneRome is for singles over 18 living in Rome who are tired of endless swiping. When a conversation starts, it is exclusive: no distractions, just the two of you.
landing.freeNote: Free to sign up, browse, like and match.
landing.how1Text: A thoughtful profile: values, lifestyle, what you are looking for. Your exact birth date and location stay private.
landing.how2Text: Every suggestion comes with a compatibility score and a clear explanation of why.
landing.how3Text: When you like each other, it's a Mutual Match. Liking and matching are free.
landing.how4Text: Start the chat and you both enter an Exclusive Connection: no new likes, no other chats, until one of you ends it.
landing.rule72Text: If a message stays unanswered for 72 hours, the connection closes by itself. Nobody stays on hold.
landing.firstDateText: When you are both ready, choose together a café, a trattoria or a museum from our selection of places.
landing.priceText: To chat, both people need an active subscription. Cancel the renewal at any time.
landing.safetyText: Email verification, report and block always available, human moderation and GDPR-compliant data handling.
landing.finalTitle: Your Roman story starts with one person.
landing.finalText: Sign up for free in two minutes. Like, match, and when it feels right, go exclusive.
landing.mockMessage2: Yes! I know the perfect place 😍
landing.neighborhoodsTitle: From Trastevere to Monti, from Prati to Pigneto
landing.statHours: hours to reply, then you're both free
landing.statFree: to sign up, like and match
landing.heroHint: Try it: swipe the cards or tap ♥
landing.mockMessage3: Perfect, see you at 6 in Piazza della Madonna dei Monti 🌅

safety.title: Safety & Privacy
safety.intro: Your safety comes first. These tools are always available, even without a subscription.
tips: Meet in a public place and arrange your own transport.
Tell a friend where and with whom you'll be.
Never send money or financial details to anyone you meet online.
Trust your instincts: you can end the connection at any time.

safety.reportEndsConnection: Reporting immediately ends any active connection with this person.
safety.blockText: You won't see each other anymore and any active connection will end immediately.
